## Patient similarity networks

If you're starting on patient similarity networks (PSN), read in this order:

1. [Patient Similarity Networks](patient-similarity-networks.qmd): Pai & Bader
   (2018), for what PSNs are and why we use them.
2. [Multi-Omics Integration](multi-omics-integration.qmd): Ritchie et al.
   (2015), for the main integration strategies and where SNF fits among them.
3. [Similarity Network Fusion](similarity-network-fusion.qmd): Wang et al.
   (2014), the method itself.
4. [Spectral Clustering and Embedding](spectral-clustering.qmd): von Luxburg
   (2007), for the clustering step that runs on the fused network.

Read the other papers on those pages when your work needs them: Rappoport &
Shamir (2018) before you choose methods to compare against, Belkin & Niyogi
(2003) and Zelnik-Manor & Perona (2004) when you tune the clustering step or
want to plot the fused network.

## Adding a paper

- Add it to the topic page where it fits, or start a new topic page if none
  does.
- Give the full citation, a DOI link, and a link to a free full text (PubMed
  Central, arXiv, or an author copy) when there is one. Then add a few lines on
  why to read it and what to focus on.
- Don't commit PDFs. This repo is public, and most publishers don't allow
  redistribution. For paywalled papers, link the DOI and get the PDF through
  the university library.
